name: processtask_step_sla_time
label: SLA Duration Table
description: The SLA duration table can be used for related queries in process-related reports.

fields.name: processtask_step_id
fields.description: Step ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: sla_id
fields.description: SLA ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type, response, handling, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: time_cost
fields.description: Time, milliseconds, calculated based on the calendar.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the processtask_step_id, sla_id, type fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_sla_id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the sla_id field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
